BF-F001: Fixed left viewer supplies marks: selecting the captured source viewer should remove SECRET while preserving KEPT-RIGHT.
Raster approval also reads the fixed left viewer: its captured viewer must own approval.
Source session/document replacement should invalidate later raster approval.
BF-F003: Exchange snapshots omit editor overlays and rotation: a complete saved snapshot should preserve output.
Measurement and redaction-marker persistence are distinct from annotation burn and require their existing writers.
DataMerge delegates to another snapshot call and needs independent preservation coverage.
BF-F004: Extraction reads the serialized file instead of pending values: complete snapshot should return Updated.
Picker lifetime can change the active source: capture page selection and origin before showing it.
Extraction sets rotations absolutely: pass complete rotations so the helper does not default output to zero.
BF-F002: Plain print source omits session rotation: a captured saved copy should rasterize landscape.
Annotated/form print has the same omission: final rotations must apply after burn.
Burn geometry must use captured visual rotations while saved output uses complete absolute rotations.
BF-F006: Post-await active metadata belongs to another document: capture all source metadata before yielding.
Current-page selection can change independently: preserve the captured page index.
Source viewer/session/document changes should cancel preparation before preview and report Canceled.

confirmedChanges: Macro redaction captures source viewer, session, and document for marks and raster approval.
Current-document Save and DataMerge macros use complete saved-copy snapshots.
Extraction captures origin and selected pages, then persists complete editor state and absolute rotations.

Printing captures immutable annotation copies, forms, stamps, rotations and preview metadata before awaiting; background work finishes an owned copy and origin mismatch reports Canceled without preview.
Macro window contains current-document and selected-PDF source choices, with current selected by default; Run routes directly without a separate source chooser.
boundaries: All nine final candidate cases passed; baseline exact symptoms failed before fixes.
Synthetic routed-control UI coverage does not certify physical input or hardware printing.
Dark macro source screenshots were inspected; full locale/theme/DPI matrix was not exercised.
Raster-redaction fallback identity guards are implemented but the fallback and timed source mutation were not replayed.
Existing complete saved-copy components provide overlay, stamp and measurement persistence; these new cases directly verify rotations, form values and redaction, not every annotation subtype.
English unsupported-annotation diagnostic remains inside the existing localized print-failure wrapper. Every current concrete annotation subtype is supported by CloneAnnotation.

Early diagnostic runs before temp redirection may have created process-owned startup-smoke roots whose exact paths were not recorded; no broad cleanup was attempted. Final runs redirect and record exact owned temporary roots under scratch.
